about.title: About Me
about.intro: Matvey Vikarchuk — photographer behind the Salty project. For several years, I've been capturing moments at weddings, events, and in nature. Every frame is a conversation between light and time—I simply listen carefully.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Shoot formats and rates

services.service2_desc: Event coverage 3+ hours. I capture all moments naturally, no staging.
services.service3_desc: From preparations to reception. Full story of your day, color correction, private online gallery.
